page.notes: Greek word after "Diaconus," printed as σύγχρον followed by an ornamental mark; the Greek is partly obscured, so the final letter is doubtful. The running head ending ("Epistolæ") is uncertain on the scan. The "Ar-" line break and "Ful-", "Ferran-", "Tri-", "ad-" breaks are kept with their printed hyphens. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. Printed "Arelatensis" and "Cæsarius" are italic in the scan; the first is not italic, only the author names and quoted phrases are. The bottom-left stain is ignored.
